page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. No margin notes. Catchword at the bottom right.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "s" in "fuapte", "fibi", "defciuiffe", "Ecclefia", "specioso" etc. was read as s. Uncertain readings: "erigéte" (accent placement) and "reuertatur" (could be read as "reuertitur"). The catchword "fed" is printed with a long s and is given as "sed". Two words of the running head are spaced letters; read as COLLOQVIVM.
